turns.en: Just checking in on you. Are you comfortable? Do you need the toilet? Can I get you anything before I go?
turns.cy: Jyst picio i mewn i'ch gweld chi. Dach chi'n gyfforddus? Dach chi angen y tŷ bach? Ga i nôl rhywbeth i chi cyn i mi fynd?
chunks: Jyst picio i mewn i'ch gweld chi
HG51 verbatim — English's 'check in on' relocates to picio i mewn i weld, the northern pop-in verb
Dach chi angen y tŷ bach?
the bare angen need-frame; no do-support
Can I get you anything before I go?
Ga i nôl rhywbeth i chi cyn i mi fynd?
the permission ga i; 'anything' → rhywbeth in the offer, the any/some distinction erasing (S9)

turns.en: Could you top up my water? And pass me my glasses from the drawer?
turns.cy: Fedrwch chi lenwi fy nŵr i? A phasio fy sbectol i o'r drôr?
chunks: Could you top up my water?
Fedrwch chi lenwi fy nŵr i?
And pass me my glasses from the drawer?
A phasio fy sbectol i o'r drôr?
English's plural 'glasses' erases — sbectol is singular in Welsh

turns.en: Of course. Water first, and let's sort this pillow out properly while I'm here. Lean forward for me a second.
turns.cy: Wrth gwrs. Dŵr gynta — a dewch i ni sortio'r clustog 'ma'n iawn tra dw i yma. Pwyswch ymlaen i mi am eiliad.
chunks: and let's sort this pillow out properly while I'm here
a dewch i ni sortio'r clustog 'ma'n iawn tra dw i yma
HG52 verbatim; the tra clause-frame; English's split particle 'sort out' has nothing to split
Lean forward for me a second
Pwyswch ymlaen i mi am eiliad

turns.en: That's better. You've a knack with pillows.
turns.cy: Mae hynna'n well. Mae gynnoch chi ddawn efo clustogau.
chunks: Mae gynnoch chi ddawn efo clustogau
possession relocates to the existential with conjugated gan
south: mae … gyda chi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Mae hynny'n well. Mae dawn gyda chi gyda gobenyddion.

turns.en: Right, you're all set. I'll be past again in an hour or so anyway.
turns.cy: Reit — dach chi wedi'ch sortio. Mi ddo i heibio eto mewn rhyw awr, beth bynnag.
chunks: HG53 verbatim — the wedi-passive; English's 'all set' has no Welsh reflex
I'll be past again in an hour or so anyway
Mi ddo i heibio eto mewn rhyw awr, beth bynnag
English's bare 'be past' needs a motion verb in Welsh — dod heibio

turns.en: An hour. Righto. I might have a little sleep.
turns.cy: Awr. Reit-o. Ella ga i gyntun bach.
chunks: I might have a little sleep
the modal relocation ella + a plain future; cyntun is the nap-noun, so 'have a sleep' becomes one word

turns.en: Just checking in. Are you comfortable? Anything you need before I go?
turns.cy: Jyst picio i mewn. Dach chi'n gyfforddus? Rhywbeth dach chi angen cyn i mi fynd?
chunks: distinct from 'checking in ON YOU' → picio i mewn i'ch gweld chi
Anything you need before I go?
Rhywbeth dach chi angen cyn i mi fynd?

turns.en: What time is it? Have I missed visiting?
turns.cy: Faint o'r gloch ydy hi? Ydw i wedi colli'r oriau ymweld?
chunks: Welsh asks 'how much of the clock', and the time is feminine hi
Ydw i wedi colli'r oriau ymweld?
colli for miss-out-on, against methu for fail-to-catch (S2); yr oriau ymweld the one head (S7)

turns.en: It's half past two, so you've not missed anything - visiting runs till eight. Expecting someone nice?
turns.cy: Mae hi'n hanner awr wedi dau, felly dach chi ddim wedi colli dim byd — mae'r oriau ymweld ymlaen tan wyth. Disgwyl rhywun neis?
chunks: Mae hi'n hanner awr wedi dau
HG54 verbatim; Welsh says 'half hour after two'
felly dach chi ddim wedi colli dim byd
mae'r oriau ymweld ymlaen tan wyth
English's 'runs' relocates to the bare adverb ymlaen
English's auxiliary erases — the bare verbal noun asks

turns.en: My son and his little one, if the traffic behaves itself.
turns.cy: Fy mab i a'i un bach o, os bydd y traffig yn bihafio.
chunks: My son and his little one
Fy mab i a'i un bach o
the echo possessives fy…i and ei…o
os bydd y traffig yn bihafio
English's reflexive 'itself' has no Welsh reflex — erased

turns.en: Something to look forward to. Ring the bell if you want a hand tidying up before they come.
turns.cy: Rhywbeth i edrych ymlaen ato. Canwch y gloch os dach chi isio help llaw i dacluso cyn iddyn nhw ddod.
chunks: HG55 verbatim; the stranded English preposition conjugates as ato
if you want a hand tidying up before they come
os dach chi isio help llaw i dacluso cyn iddyn nhw ddod
the cyn i clause-frame with a conjugated iddyn nhw

turns.en: You're very good to me. Go on now, I'm fine.
turns.cy: Dach chi'n dda iawn wrtha i. Ewch chi rŵan, dw i'n iawn.
chunks: Dach chi'n dda iawn wrtha i
kindness-toward takes wrth in Welsh, not i — a preposition English does not distinguish
distinct from 'Go on' alone → Ewch amdani; here it is a dismissal, not a propulsion

turns.en: Just checking in on you. Do you need the toilet? Can I get you anything?
turns.cy: Jyst picio i mewn i'ch gweld chi. Dach chi angen y tŷ bach? Ga i nôl rhywbeth i chi?
chunks: Jyst picio i mewn i'ch gweld chi
Dach chi angen y tŷ bach?
Ga i nôl rhywbeth i chi?

turns.en: I need the toilet, actually. Can you help me? I'm sorry to be a nuisance.
turns.cy: Dw i angen y tŷ bach, a deud y gwir. Fedrwch chi fy helpu i? Mae'n ddrwg gen i fod yn niwsans.
chunks: Dw i angen y tŷ bach
I'm sorry to be a nuisance
Mae'n ddrwg gen i fod yn niwsans
regret relocates to mae'n ddrwg gen i — the N-form fork
south: mae'n ddrwg gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Dw i angen y tŷ bach, a gweud y gwir. Allwch chi fy helpu i? Mae'n ddrwg gyda fi fod yn niwsans.

turns.en: Of course - no need to apologise. Let's take it steady, hold onto my arm.
turns.cy: Wrth gwrs — dim angen ymddiheuro. Dewch i ni fynd gan bwyll — gafaelwch yn fy mraich i.
chunks: HG56 verbatim; the bare angen frame in its negative (R3)
Dewch i ni fynd gan bwyll
the pace family's fourth form (R4); English's 'take it' becomes a going-verb

turns.en: Thank you. Sorry to keep ringing that bell.
turns.cy: Diolch. Sori am ddal i ganu'r gloch 'na.
chunks: Sorry to keep ringing that bell
Sori am ddal i ganu'r gloch 'na
dal i + verbal noun for 'keep -ing'; sori kept apart from mae'n ddrwg gen i, which renders the full 'I'm sorry'

turns.en: Ring away - that's what it's for. I'd rather ten small things than one big thing we missed.
turns.cy: Canwch chi faint fynnoch chi — dyna i be mae hi. Mae'n well gen i ddeg peth bach nag un peth mawr wnaethon ni ei fethu.
chunks: HG57 verbatim — the X-away frame relocates to 'as much as you will'
the purpose-cleft (R3); feminine hi for the bell
I'd rather ten small things than one big thing we missed
Mae'n well gen i ddeg peth bach nag un peth mawr wnaethon ni ei fethu
preference relocates to mae'n well gen i — the N-form fork; methu for fail-to-catch, against colli for miss-out-on (S2)
south: mae'n well gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Canwch chi faint fynnoch chi — dyna i beth mae hi. Mae'n well gyda fi ddeg peth bach nag un peth mawr wnaethon ni ei fethu.

turns.en: You're a kind girl. Thank you.
chunks: the English indefinite article erases; clên the one kind-lexeme (R7)
